title: SEBI Tightens Margin Trading Facility (MTF) Rules: Net Worth Limit Raised to ₹5 Crore
summary: Raises broker net worth requirement from ₹3 crore to ₹5 crore and allows LLPs to offer MTFs.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 SEBI Tightens Margin Trading Facility (MTF) Rules: Net Worth Limit Raised to ₹5 Crore. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Raises broker net worth requirement from ₹3 crore to ₹5 crore and allows LLPs to offer MTFs.
Net Worth Cap: Broker net worth requirement raised from ₹3 crore to ₹5 crore; LLPs permitted.
Locked Net Worth: Locked-away amount = lower of 2x min net worth or 50% total net worth.
Exposure Ceiling: Remaining net worth usable for MTF within overall exposure limit of 5.5x net worth (single client cap 10%).
Broker net worth cap (₹5 crore) vs MTF exposure limit (5.5x net worth).
